about_the_game:
Tribes is a real-time strategy game where survival means outsmarting, outgrowing, and out-fighting every other tribe on the island. Can you rise from humble beginnings to build the strongest army, or will your people be wiped out by rival clans?

Start with just a small group of villagers. Gather resources, construct buildings, and train warriors as you grow your settlement into a thriving, battle-hardened tribe. Every choice matters—will you expand quickly, build up powerful defenses, or strike first and crush your enemies before they gain strength?

Features:

  • Build and Conquer – Grow your village, manage your resources, and raise a powerful army.

  • Real-time Battles – Take command in fast-paced skirmishes where every move counts.

  • Single-player Campaign – Battle against ruthless AI tribes in a challenging, evolving world.

  • Dynamic World – Changing terrain, weather, and events keep every game fresh.

  • Tribal Warfare – Unlock unique units and abilities to shape your tribe’s destiny.

Join the Discord Server for updates regarding the game!!

Developed by Catastrophe Studios, Tribes brings classic RTS gameplay with a fresh competitive twist. Only the strongest tribe will survive. Will it be yours?

Currently in version Beta 0.1.0

name: Tribes

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 128 MB video memory capable of Shader model 2.0+
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: TRIBES
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Dual Core 3.0 Ghz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 256mb Video Memory, capable of Shader Model 2.0+
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: TRIBES

short_description: In a stone-age like war, stuck on a lush, isolated island, its down to you to command your tribe to conquer and colonize the island by any means! Tribes offers skirmish, multiplayer and a full campaign mode for you to experience with friends or alone!!!
